retainedContract.invariant: Unavailable platform POS evidence must abstain and must not become a confident lexical class.
retainedContract.consequence: OtherWord cannot participate as a confident class in POS reconciliation or create a distinct confident lexical identity.

limitations: This check changes only the OtherWord interpretation; existing explicit POS mappings and the unsupported .other bucket remain unchanged.
Remote Architecture CI for the new generator commit must still complete after publication.
